spec.studio_prompt: A modern single bed measuring 100 cm wide, 200 cm long, and 100 cm high with a thick, softly arched headboard upholstered in oatmeal cream fabric (#beb7af). The bed is dressed in relaxed, floor-draping warm greige washed linen bedding (#9f8c77). Resting against the headboard is a plump square accent pillow in deep rust brown (#54301c), paired with a smooth clay brown folded throw blanket (#816145) draped across the lower half. The upholstered base seamlessly coordinates with the headboard, exhibiting clean contours and rich textile textures.
